description: Source file implementing the HttpAuthHandler class for handling HTTP authentication challenges, token generation, and challenge handling within the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandler
classes.description: Class responsible for handling HTTP authentication challenges, generating auth tokens, and managing challenge responses.

methods.name: InitFromChallenge
methods.description: Initializes the handler from an authentication challenge, setting up necessary parameters and logging.

methods.name: GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an authentication token based on provided credentials and request info, with callback handling.

methods.name: NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Indicates whether the handler needs an identity for authentication.

methods.name: AllowsDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Indicates whether default credentials are allowed.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Indicates whether explicit credentials are allowed.

methods.name: OnGenerateAuthTokenComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of auth token generation.

methods.name: FinishGenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Finalizes the auth token generation process, logging and resetting callback.

methods.name: HandleAnotherChallenge
methods.description: Handles additional authentication challenges and logs the result.
